en.io: Input is a feature description. Output is docs/specs/{feature-name}.md containing the problem, metrics, stories, acceptance criteria, scope, dependencies, risks, questions, and handoff information.
en.boundary: The workflow writes a specification but does not implement or verify the feature. It expects clarification rather than guessing, while the evidence does not define the exact specification template, naming normalization, or approval mechanism.
dependencies: A Prometeo product-management agent or equivalent spec author
Access to existing specifications for conflict research
SIGN IN, Spec Completion, TIME OUT, and SIGN OUT checklists referenced but not included
scenarios: Define a new feature or business requirement.
Write user stories with GIVEN/WHEN/THEN acceptance criteria.
Record dependencies, risks, success measures, open questions, and developer handoff notes.

zh.io: 输入为功能描述；输出为 docs/specs/{feature-name}.md，包含问题、指标、故事、验收标准、范围、依赖、风险、问题和交接信息。
zh.boundary: 该工作流只编写规格，不实现也不验证功能。它要求遇到不明确内容时询问，而非猜测；但证据未定义确切规格模板、名称规范化或审批机制。
dependencies: Prometeo 产品管理智能体或等效规格作者
用于冲突研究的现有规格访问权限
证据未包含的 SIGN IN、Spec Completion、TIME OUT 和 SIGN OUT 清单
scenarios: 定义新功能或业务需求。
编写带 GIVEN/WHEN/THEN 验收标准的用户故事。
区分范围内和范围外工作。
记录依赖、风险、成功指标、开放问题和开发交接说明。
